description: This file is the entry point for a React-based front-end application. It imports React, ReactDOM, CSS styles, and the main App component, and renders the App component inside a DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering the React application into the DOM element with specified id.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the root DOM node.
